name: Short-form hook edit
description: Fast vertical edit for Shorts, Reels and TikTok: payoff-first hook text in the first two seconds, a promise callout and a short loop end card. Interrupt zooms, captions and sound effects are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

beats.name: Payoff-first hook
beats.guidance: Lead with the payoff or a contradiction; never with an intro.

beats.name: Promise
beats.guidance: Say what the viewer will get, with a number if it is true.

beats.name: Delivery
beats.guidance: Short shots, around three seconds or less.

beats.name: Loop or next
beats.guidance: End so the video can loop, or point to the next one.

deferred.title: Short high-contrast captions
deferred.description: Captions on screen for at least two seconds each.

deferred.title: Interrupt zooms
deferred.description: Zooms and freeze-frames that restart attention.

deferred.title: Sound effects on interrupts
deferred.description: A short effect at each interrupt.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Claims about results, savings, speed or income need evidence you can show. Avoid guarantees, and say 'results vary' next to any result you show.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
